headline: STB enters insolvency after debts exceed 1.6 billion lei - Forbes.ro
summary: Romanian company STB has entered insolvency proceedings after its debts exceeded 1.6 billion lei, according to Forbes Romania. The report gives no further details on the company's business.
why: Insolvency proceedings can lead to asset sales, creditor losses and restructuring, which matter for lenders, suppliers and investors exposed to Romanian corporate credit.
